phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economy and early defense.
phase_policies.live_check: Reassess when you have a solid economy and the opponent's tech direction becomes clearer.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Establish economy and defense, produce queens, tech towards midgame.
phase_policies.target: Maintain economy and expansion rate while producing queens for defense. Continue teching towards a midgame composition.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-expand without maintaining a defensive force; avoid neglecting army production while focusing on economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, continue expanding and increasing production.
phase_policies.live_check: Reassess when you have a strong army and the opponent's tech choices are more apparent.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Expand and increase production, invest in tech, maintain ground army.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen ground army and increase production. Maintain expansion rate and start investing more in technology.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in tech at the expense of army size and scouting; avoid passivity that lets Terran dictate pace.

phase_policies.applies_when: Entering the midgame, focus on increasing technology and production to match the opponent's heavy investment.
phase_policies.live_check: Reassess when you have a solid army composition and the opponent's tech direction is clear.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Increase tech and production, expand, strengthen ground army with counter units.
phase_policies.target: Increase technology and production to match opponent. Continue expanding and strengthening ground army. Consider adding Hydralisks or Roaches to counter ground forces.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Tech Investment
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-expand without defense; avoid neglecting army production while teching up.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the late-midgame, focus on strengthening your army and maintaining your economy.
phase_policies.live_check: Reassess when you have a strong army and the opponent's composition is known.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, increase tech, maintain economy and production.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen ground army and increase technology. Maintain expansion and production. Consider Hydralisk-based army and upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in tech at the expense of army size; avoid neglecting scouting and defense.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
